intro: I’m Rakib Ahmed — a graphic designer focused on esports, gaming and digital visuals. I build bold, structured graphics for teams, tournaments and brands.
about: I create graphics that help teams, events and digital brands communicate clearly and look distinctive. My focus is combining strong hierarchy, intentional typography and colour with the energy of gaming culture.

I’m comfortable working from a creative brief, adapting to established brand systems and refining details through feedback. I’m currently studying at Tejgaon College and building my professional design practice.
